def: a complete collection; especially a Christian meeting (for worship)

occurrences.text: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,
Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
